data.title: 墨染希 · 神社缘侧的月华白襦微露
data.description: 深夜静谧的神社内院，银白月光洒在光洁的木质缘侧上。希仅着一袭纯白的真丝内襦，领口微松，衬托出精致纤细的锁骨与雪肌。晚风卷落庭院中的几片枫叶，少女侧坐在木廊边，玉指轻拢乌黑的长发，眼波流转间满是神明巫女独有的圣洁与深情诱惑。
data.location: tranquil moonlit wooden veranda of traditional shrine overlooking stone garden
data.action: sitting gracefully on wooden shrine veranda in moonlight, sheer white inner kimono loosely draped, black hair falling over shoulder, alluring serene smile
data.lighting: crystal silver moonlight casting deep gentle shadows on traditional wooden architecture
data.mood: sacred ethereal sensuality, timeless poetic devotion
data.promptProse: Sitting gracefully upon the wooden veranda of a silent moonlit shrine, Nozomi Sumizome wears a flowing white inner kimono. Her long black hair cascades over bare shoulders as she smiles with serene, otherworldly allure.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi sitting on a moonlit shrine veranda in a white inner kimono, smiling serenely.
